description: Wever Briefs: plain-language summary of a Base address’s recent USDC flows from public on-chain Transfer logs. Inputs: address and optional window_days (default 30, maximum 90). Returns totals in and out, net flow, the largest transfers, the counterparty address count with the top counterparties by volume, and the exact time window covered. Counterparties appear as on-chain addresses. POST /api/wallet-activity-brief. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns one brief with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/briefs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/briefs/.

address.description: Public Base address. Mixed-case input must carry a valid EIP-55 checksum; all-lowercase input is normalized.

window_days.description: Days before the check time to cover. Default 30.

name: wever_wallet-activity-brief
title: Wallet activity brief
